import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv", nrows=None)
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv", nrows=None)
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv", nrows=None)

print(f"Train shape: {train.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test.shape}")
print(f"Unique cover types: {train['Cover_Type'].nunique()}")
print(
    f"Cover type distribution: {train['Cover_Type'].value_counts().head(10).to_dict()}"
)

# Features and target
feature_cols = [col for col in train.columns if col not in ["Id", "Cover_Type"]]
X_train = train[feature_cols].copy()
y_train = train["Cover_Type"]
X_test = test[feature_cols].copy()
test_id = test["Id"]

# Feature Engineering
print("Creating engineered features...")

# Sum of wilderness areas (categorical)
X_train["Wilderness_Sum"] = X_train[
    ["Wilderness_Area1", "Wilderness_Area2", "Wilderness_Area3", "Wilderness_Area4"]
].sum(axis=1)
X_test["Wilderness_Sum"] = X_test[
    ["Wilderness_Area1", "Wilderness_Area2", "Wilderness_Area3", "Wilderness_Area4"]
].sum(axis=1)


# Ratio of horizontal to vertical hydrology distance (where not zero)
def hydrology_ratio(row):
    if row["Horizontal_Distance_To_Hydrology"] > 0:
        return (
            row["Vertical_Distance_To_Hydrology"]
            / row["Horizontal_Distance_To_Hydrology"]
        )
    return 0.0


X_train["Hydrology_Ratio"] = X_train.apply(hydrology_ratio, axis=1)
X_test["Hydrology_Ratio"] = X_test.apply(hydrology_ratio, axis=1)

# Combined elevation and slope interaction
X_train["Elevation_Slope_Product"] = X_train["Elevation"] * X_train["Slope"]
X_test["Elevation_Slope_Product"] = X_test["Elevation"] * X_test["Slope"]

# Hillshade sum across times of day
X_train["Hillshade_Sum"] = X_train[
    ["Hillshade_9am", "Hillshade_Noon", "Hillshade_3pm"]
].sum(axis=1)
X_test["Hillshade_Sum"] = X_test[
    ["Hillshade_9am", "Hillshade_Noon", "Hillshade_3pm"]
].sum(axis=1)

# Road and fire point distance ratio
X_train["Road_Fire_Ratio"] = X_train["Horizontal_Distance_To_Roadways"] / (
    X_train["Horizontal_Distance_To_Fire_Points"] + 1
)
X_test["Road_Fire_Ratio"] = X_test["Horizontal_Distance_To_Roadways"] / (
    X_test["Horizontal_Distance_To_Fire_Points"] + 1
)

print(f"Total features after engineering: {len(X_train.columns)}")

# Create hold-out validation split from training data (NOT stratified due to class imbalance issues)
print("Creating validation split...")
X_train_fold, X_val, y_train_fold, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.1, random_state=42
)

# Train LightGBM classifier with best hyperparameters from previous solution
print("Training LightGBM model...")
model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=100,
    max_depth=6,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=31,
    min_child_samples=20,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    verbose=-1,
    n_jobs=-1,
    random_state=42,
)

model.fit(X_train_fold, y_train_fold)

# Validate on hold-out set
print("Validating on hold-out set...")
y_val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation accuracy: {val_accuracy:.6f}")

# Generate predictions on test set
print("Generating test predictions...")
y_test_pred = model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission
submission = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_id, "Cover_Type": y_test_pred})

# Save submission
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission rows: {len(submission)}")
print(f"Submission columns: {list(submission.columns)}")
